questions.q: What are your two choices when burnt out, according to lesson 1?
a: Take a break or get obsessed

questions.q: What happens to your work if you become obsessed?
a: It energizes you instead of exhausting you
questions.why: Lesson 1 says work will energize you.

questions.q: In which two ways does fear come, per lesson 2?
a: Fear of rejection and fear of failure
Fear of success and fear of change
Fear of money and fear of time
Fear of pain and fear of loss

questions.why: Lesson 2 mentions her speech about rejection.

questions.q: How should you treat haters, per lesson 3?
a: Be grateful and use them as motivation
questions.why: Lesson 3 says to see haters as a sign of success.
